intervention: Replace greedy center-distance diversity with overlap diversity in both roles. Retain native per-role token scores, the first slot, four slots, the penalty 4.0 and all source checkpoints.
overlap: Maximum of axis-aligned proposal-box IoU and point-support Jaccard on the R175 frozen seed coordinates. Point-support Jaccard applies when each support has at least four seeds; otherwise use box IoU.
unchanged: Same A256 order and underlying boxes; same point draw, RGB, parsed spans, role scores, PCA, all pair_only parameters, within-slot normalization and final readout.
selection: One fixed intervention with no parameter search or label inputs. Use complete ordinary six-direction Validation and all positive and negative paired outcomes.
primary: Six-direction equally weighted Acc@25 and Acc@50; mIoU, paired outcomes, full/slot coverage and supported-relation subsets explain the result.
decision: Assess performance against original pair_only and R158+PCA. Coverage gain alone cannot establish a new main method.
